answer: Farming becomes a terrace bet on surviving 81 epochs of grading, and every quartz settlement recomputes the pulse schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 81 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
